name: Tamil Nadu BOCW Welfare Board - Accident Relief Scheme
tamil_name: தமிழ்நாடு கட்டுமானத் தொழிலாளர்கள் நல வாரியம் - விபத்து நிவாரணத் திட்டம்
department: Tamil Nadu Construction Workers Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Govt of Tamil Nadu
target_beneficiaries: Registered construction workers in Tamil Nadu
Manual and daily wage workers engaged in building or civil works in Tamil Nadu
eligibility_criteria: Must be a worker residing or working in Tamil Nadu
Must be an active registered member with TNBOCW Welfare Board (or enrolled in TNUWWB)
Accident or injury must have occurred during or as a result of employment or commute to work
Must have valid proof of medical treatment or disability
benefit_description: Financial compensation and medical reimbursement for registered construction workers facing workplace injury, disability, or death.
benefit_limits: Accidental Death: Up to ₹5,00,000; Permanent Total Disability (loss of both limbs/eyes): Up to ₹2,00,000; Partial permanent disability: ₹50,000 - ₹1,00,000; Grievous injury hospitalization: ₹10,000 - ₹25,000.
required_documents: TNBOCW Welfare Board Membership Card / Registration Number
Medical Certificate / Hospital Discharge Summary
Disability Certificate issued by Government Medical Board (if permanent disability)
FIR / Police GD Entry or Employer Accident Notice
Copy of Bank Passbook (active single-holder account)
Aadhaar Card Copy
Passport size photographs
application_procedure: Submit claim Form through the official TNUWWB portal (https://tnuwwb.tn.gov.in) or submit directly to the District Labour Officer (Social Security Scheme) within 6 months of the accident.
verification_notes: Verified against Tamil Nadu Unorganised Workers Welfare Board statutory benefit schedules.

name: Employees' Compensation Act, 1923 (Statutory Workplace Injury Compensation)
tamil_name: பணியாளர் இழப்பீட்டுச் சட்டம் 1923 (தொழிலிட விபத்து சட்டபூர்வ இழப்பீடு)
department: Ministry of Labour & Employment, Govt of India / Commissioner for Employees' Compensation
target_beneficiaries: Any worker (including daily wage, casual, or contract construction workers) who suffers personal injury arising out of and in the course of employment
Applies regardless of whether employer registered worker with BOCW board
eligibility_criteria: Worker must have suffered personal injury in an accident arising out of and in the course of employment
Applies in all States and Union Territories across India
Employer has statutory legal liability to provide compensation under Section 3 & 4 of the Act
Applicable even if worker has no formal written contract if work relationship is provable
benefit_description: Statutory legal compensation paid by employer/principal contractor for injury, permanent disablement, or death suffered during work.
benefit_limits: Permanent Total Disablement: Formula based on 60% of monthly wages multiplied by age factor (statutory minimum ₹1,40,000 up to ₹10,00,000+); Temporary disablement: Half-monthly payments of 25% of wages during recovery; Full medical expense reimbursement.
required_documents: Medical treatment records, hospital admission/discharge summary, injury memo
Proof of employment relation (muster roll, wage slip, contractor work order, supervisor message, or co-worker witness affidavits)
Written notice of accident submitted to employer/contractor
Disability assessment certificate from government doctor
Identity proof and Bank Account details
application_procedure: Deliver written notice of accident to employer. If employer refuses compensation, file a claim petition (Form F) before the Commissioner for Employees' Compensation (District Labour Court) within 2 years of accident.
verification_notes: Central statutory remedy under the Employees' Compensation Act 1923 (formerly Workmen's Compensation Act).

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
tamil_name: ஆயுஷ்மான் பாரத் - பிரதமர் மக்கள் ஆரோக்கியத் திட்டம் (இலவச மருத்துவக் காப்பீடு)
department: National Health Authority (NHA), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Govt of India
target_beneficiaries: Bottom 40% vulnerable and unorganized worker families
Daily wage construction workers with eligible SECC / State Ration Cards (PHH / BPL)
eligibility_criteria: Family identified as eligible under SECC / State Food Security list / Priority Household (PHH) card
Available across empanelled public and private hospitals across India
No restriction on family size, age, or gender
benefit_description: Comprehensive cashless inpatient secondary and tertiary hospital treatment for trauma, surgery, and critical care.
benefit_limits: Up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year on a cashless, paperless basis at empanelled hospitals.
required_documents: Ayushman Card / State Health Card (e.g., CMCHIS card in Tamil Nadu)
Aadhaar Card or Government Photo Identity Card
Ration Card / Family Card verifying priority household status
application_procedure: Present Aadhaar card and Ration card at the Ayushman Mitra kiosk at any empanelled government or private hospital for instant verification and cashless admission.
verification_notes: Central health assurance scheme integrated with state schemes like Tamil Nadu CMCHIS.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
tamil_name: பிரதமர் சுரக்ஷா பீமா யோஜனா (விபத்துக் காப்பீட்டுத் திட்டம்)
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India
target_beneficiaries: All individuals aged 18 to 70 with an active savings bank account who enrolled with annual premium deduction (₹20/year)
eligibility_criteria: Age between 18 and 70 years
Having a savings bank account with annual auto-debit consent (₹20/year)
Disability or death must be directly caused by accident
benefit_description: Affordable accidental death and disability insurance cover for low-income and daily wage workers.
benefit_limits: Accidental death: ₹2,00,000; Total irrecoverable loss of both eyes or both limbs: ₹2,00,000; Irrecoverable loss of one eye or one limb: ₹1,00,000.
required_documents: PMSBY Claim Form (available at bank)
Hospital Discharge summary & Medical attendant certificate
Disability Certificate from competent government medical authority
Bank passbook copy showing ₹20 auto-debit premium transaction
Police FIR / Panchanama or Hospital Accidental Injury Certificate
Aadhaar Card copy
application_procedure: Submit completed claim form and medical records to the bank branch where the auto-debit premium was deducted within 30 days of the injury or discharge.
verification_notes: Low-cost accident insurance scheme administered through commercial and rural banks.

name: e-Shram National Database for Unorganised Workers
tamil_name: இ-ஷ்ராம் தேசிய அமைப்புசாரா தொழிலாளர் நலப் பதிவு
department: Ministry of Labour & Employment, Govt of India
target_beneficiaries: All unorganized workers, daily wage laborers, and construction workers aged 16 to 59 not covered by EPFO/ESIC
eligibility_criteria: Must be an unorganized worker aged 16 to 59 years
Must not be an income taxpayer
Must not be a member of EPFO or ESIC
benefit_description: National portable identity (Universal Account Number - UAN) and access to central welfare and accidental social security support.
benefit_limits: Provides 12-digit UAN Card; Accidental death cover of ₹2,00,000 and partial disability cover of ₹1,00,000 under integrated insurance provisions.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card
Mobile number linked with Aadhaar
Bank Account details (Account number and IFSC code)
application_procedure: Free self-registration online at https://eshram.gov.in or through nearest Common Service Centre (CSC).
verification_notes: National portal for unorganized worker social security linking.

name: Karnataka BOCW Welfare Board - Accident Benefit Scheme
tamil_name: கர்நாடக கட்டுமானத் தொழிலாளர்கள் நல வாரியம் - விபத்து நிவாரணம்
department: Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Govt of Karnataka
target_beneficiaries: Registered construction workers working in Karnataka with valid KBOCW identity card
eligibility_criteria: Must be a worker residing or working in Karnataka
Must have completed at least 90 days of construction work in Karnataka
Must be an active registered member with KBOCW Welfare Board
Accident or injury must be certified by medical authority
benefit_description: Ex-gratia relief and medical treatment assistance for registered construction workers in Karnataka injured on duty.
benefit_limits: Accidental Death: ₹5,00,000; Permanent Total Disability: ₹2,00,000; Major surgery/grievous injury: Up to ₹50,000; Hospitalization: ₹10,000 - ₹20,000.
required_documents: KBOCW Identity Card / Smart Card
Employer Certificate confirming 90 days work in construction
Hospital Discharge Summary and bills
Medical Board Disability Certificate (for permanent disability)
Police FIR / Accident Inspection Report
Bank Passbook copy and Aadhaar copy
application_procedure: Apply online through Seva Sindhu or KBOCWWB portal (https://kbocwwb.karnataka.gov.in) or submit to Senior Labour Inspector / District Labour Officer within 6 months.
